changes: Resolve const bindings by lexical identity, including immutable aliases and shadowing.
Reject mutated or escaped argument arrays, checking every binding in an alias chain.
Reject unresolved argument arrays, subcommands and revision arguments.
Forbid shell execution and shell-enabled process options; normalize supported direct Git global options and reject unknown ones.
Preserve the existing controlled wrappers and the closed published commit allowance.
Extend the runtime Git shim to catch SHA reads after global options while retaining HEAD and main controls.
